cards.title: NCA Terminal Phase Data Requirements and Validity
cards.claim: Terminal-dependent NCA endpoints (lambda_z, t1/2, AUCinf) require explicit verification of terminal phase validity. The last few observations do not automatically constitute a valid terminal phase. Inputs must include quantifiable observations, BLQ status, and dosing/infusion timing to distinguish terminal decline from ongoing input. A universal minimum sampling count or fit-statistic threshold is not established; adequacy is assessed per endpoint.
limitations: Cannot certify usable terminal estimate if inputs are incomplete
Software default acceptance criteria are not sufficient evidence of adequacy
Group-mean terminal curves do not yield individual parameter distributions

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
